title: introduce-rag-playbook-cli-with-step-snapshots-and-compact-telemetry-adapter
author: Asha Menon
release_notes: Adds a lightweight CLI for authoring and running retrieval-augmented playbooks locally, plus an optional telemetry adapter for step-level snapshots and replayable JSON traces.
description: Motivation: provide a small, batteries-included CLI that lets engineers author, run, and replay RAG playbooks locally with deterministic step snapshots and compact telemetry for debugging and quick evals. This PR adds a rag-playbook CLI binary, a compact telemetry adapter that emits newline-delimited JSON step traces, a deterministic replay mode for step-by-step debugging, a set of example playbooks and templates, and a docs quickstart. Scope: examples/rag-playbook-cli (implementation and templates), docs/site/content/quickstarts/rag-playbook-cli.md (quickstart + troubleshooting), examples/test-fixtures/playbooks (seeded test inputs), ci/smoke/rag-cli-smoke.yml (CI smoke job), and a small integration test harness under examples/tests/rag_cli_integration_test.py. Checklist: - [x] CLI to run a single playbook with --snapshot and --trace-output options - [x] Telemetry adapter that produces compact NDJSON step events (start/end, inputs, outputs, metrics) - [x] Replay mode to feed snapshots back into the runner for deterministic debugging - [x] Example playbooks (faq-bot, docs-summarizer, jira-assistant) - [x] Quickstart docs and code snippets - [x] Smoke CI job and unit tests - [x] Type-checked TypeScript bindings for the example tool adapters Backwards compatibility: runtime APIs are unchanged; the CLI and telemetry adapter are opt-in. Related work: ENG-2104 (playbook authoring epics), ENG-2120 (telemetry lightweight traces), and a follow-up task ENG-2222 for server-side ingestion of the NDJSON traces. The description below summarizes the changes and reviewer thread; see files changed for details.

human_readable_summary: This PR introduces a small CLI for running RAG playbooks locally, captures per-step snapshots for deterministic replay, and adds a compact NDJSON telemetry adapter for developer debugging and local evals. It includes example templates, docs, tests, and a CI smoke job. The change is opt-in and intended to improve the developer feedback loop for authoring RAG flows.
